# Your customers are talking to your AI.   Are you sure it's safe?

WonderSuite gives enterprise teams the intelligence to find hidden risks, enforce policy, and detect drift across the AI lifecycle.

WonderSuite is the AI security platform for teams launching customer-facing AI in regulated industries. Test your security and safety posture before launch. Protect your AI experience in production. Catch what changes over time.

[Get a Demo](https://alice.io/demo) [Download Platform Overview](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69005ca0f0832195cbc1370c/6a28b59119cbe9d4739ddaf0_WonderSuite_Overview.pdf)

## The _security layer_ your AI needs before it ever reaches your users.

Built-in model guardrails weren't designed for your application, your customers, or your regulatory environment. WonderSuite was. Our platform combines automated adversarial testing with expert-led red teaming and real-time protection.

#### Know what's exploitable before you launch

[WonderBuild](https://alice.io/products/wonderbuild) stress-tests your AI against thousands of adversarial inputs for jailbreaks, prompt injections, data extraction attempts, & more, and surfaces what needs to be fixed before you ever launch.

#### Intercept harmful outputs in real time

[WonderFence](https://alice.io/products/wonderfence) deploys continuously evolving runtime guardrails tuned to your application and policies, intercepting harmful, non-compliant, or off-brand responses the moment they occur, with no meaningful impact to latency.

#### Stay secure as your AI changes over time

Model updates, prompt changes, and new attack techniques create new vulnerabilities. [WonderCheck](https://alice.io/products/wondercheck) runs continuous automated red teaming in production so regressions and emerging risks don't go undetected.
